contract.hypothesis: Within the original candidate universe, price distribution weighted by historical close-times-volume activity may distinguish long-term trend quality.
contract.measurement: At official session t, ref=adj[t-42], hist=adj[t-252:t-42], g=(ref-hist)/(ref+hist). Candidate=sum(close*volume*g)/sum(close*volume)-mean(g); control=mean(g).
contract.availability: Shared candidate/control mask requires all211 adjusted prices positive finite, all210 raw closes positive finite, all210 volumes nonnegative finite and positive total activity. No fill, substitution or calendar compression.
contract.rank: Average centered percentile within all49 original monthly candidates sharing availability; NOT filtered by stock eligibility or model availability. Missing cells and rows with fewer than2 available cells have zero rank and delta.
contract.scoring: Add fixed0.02*rank (absolute delta <=0.01) to frozen Local67 pre-score, then exactly one original episode. First partial2016-08-17 allocation gets zero new delta.
contract.portfolio: Unchanged eligibility and historical proxy Top32+theme17; long-only EW3/two halves/under2 cash; fixed adjusted units intramonth; difference rebalance; no terminal liquidation.
contract.limitation: Reused development sample, historical vendor vintages and estimated membership, not pristine OOS/PIT. close*volume is a fixed source-unit activity proxy, not certified actual turnover, money flow or owner cost basis. It can be affected by vendor split/volume conventions.
contract.historical_best_tracking: FROZEN selection and latest_training_selected_candidate use first88 only. Legacy best_training_selected_candidate records the posthoc full-period maximum among first88-selected candidates; descriptive, not independent validation or observer promotion.
